phrase: a Cricket Sensor and Analytics Business
verdict: Yes, for a founder with hardware and cricket knowledge. Str8bat pitched a bat sensor that tracks batting data on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Academies and ambitious young players want data like the professionals, but hardware development is expensive and slow.
angle: Sensors and apps can measure bat speed, swing angle and timing. Academies use the data for coaching, and parents of young players pay for progress reports. Durability and accuracy are critical, and you'll need to keep the app useful so players keep using it.
